items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: that’s how I can tell the difference between Coltrane’s I mean Miles’s bands

ctx.x: I’d like to congratulate you on two things: making a living as a musician, and playing what I consider to be the most important instrument in any band.

Wow. That’s a good couple of things. Thank you for both of those. And I always thought it was kind of like — because I’m a bass player when I listen to a band that’s what I’m listening to is the the better the bass player, the better the band, and that’s how I can tell the difference between Coltrane’s I mean Miles’s bands, you know I say, “Oh that’s Percy Heath,” “Oh that’s Paul Chambers,” “Oh that’s Ron Carter.”
For you what is the most obvious thing, from that basis, that tells you that, who it is?
